title: feat(plugin-gantt): object-gantt is judged and publishes the eleven spec keys its renderer honours (objectui#11168 slice 4)
body:
Refs #11168

Clause-②: yes (widening). The `object-gantt` registration publishes eleven more inputs (`navigation`, `label`, `skipWeekends`, `holidays`, `persistLayout`, `viewName`, `markers`, `criticalPath`, `showBaselines`, `readOnly`, `mobileReadOnly`), so the page validator accepts eleven keys it used to report as `unknown-prop`. Nothing narrows: a wrongly typed value of one of those keys moves from an `unknown-prop` warning to a `type-mismatch` warning, the same severity, and no schema face changes. The fixed group ships it as `minor`.

objectui#11168 slice 4. objectui#11111 decision 3 = B applies (record `5902351047`): every key is decided by its own measurement through the real `SchemaRenderer`, and only what the renderer honours is declared. Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01VhxTqosz7wn54ahqyxgERT` (dispatched by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat, claim `5932630849`).

## What this PR takes

| Item | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Load and judge | The parity guard eager-imports `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`; `object-gantt` joins `MINOR_17_5_LOADED_BLOCKS` and its OWED row in `UNJUDGED_SPEC_BLOCKS` is struck |
| The eleven unpublished row keys | All eleven measured honoured and declared |
| `gantt` description | No longer names `percentageField` (nothing reads it, and the spec refuses it by name); starts with the row's own describe |
| Member pins | Ten registered: seven in the new `objectGanttInputs-11168.test.tsx`, and `data`, `staticData`, `dataSource` promoted from pre-existing files after an end-to-end read |
| Ledger | By census: caps `unjudgedBlocks 1 / offSpecInputs 0 / unpublishedKeys 3 / refusedArms 0 / memberPins 0`, owner `objectui#11168` 4; census 38 judged + 7 propless + 10 ledgered = 55 |
| Mirrors | No edit owed (see H5 below) |
| Docs | README and the docs page say what each key does, as measured; `readme-navigation-example` follows the README's new authored example |

## Measurements (before any edit, on the unchanged renderer)

Predictions were written to files before each probe ran; every row came out as predicted. The probes were throwaway files, deleted before the first commit.

**Census.** With only the import added, the guard went red on exactly the predicted rows: the reverse direction listed the eleven keys, the member-pin direction listed `gantt`, `data`, `staticData`, `filter`, `sort`, `dataSource`, and the four census rows moved. The forward direction, the arm judge and the member-kind judge stayed green.

**Each key**, authored in the spec's `properties` bag, through `SchemaRenderer` into the real `GanttView`:
- `label`: names the exported PNG file. A string as written; the locale map `{ en, zh-CN }` gave the zh-CN entry for a zh-CN audience and the en entry for an en one; a node-level `label` reads the same; `gantt.exportFileName` outranks it, and it outranks the object's label, then `objectName`. It is drawn nowhere else.
- `skipWeekends`: auto-schedule moved a dependent task to Mon 2026-03-09 (Saturday 2026-03-07 without it); the day axis dropped the Sat/Sun columns.
- `holidays`: `2026-03-07` alone moved the successor to 03-08; with `skipWeekends` and `2026-03-09` it went to 03-10; the day axis dropped `2026-03-04`'s column, an empty list dropped nothing.
- `persistLayout` / `viewName`: saving wrote `gantt-layout:task:default` and its `:filters` sibling; `false` removed the save-layout button and wrote nothing; `viewName: board` wrote `task:board` (and `gantt:board` on inline rows naming no object); a saved `board` layout restored only under `viewName: board`.
- `markers`: drew the line with its label and colour; an omitted colour painted the theme primary; a 2031 date drew none.
- `criticalPath`: seeded the toggle pressed and the bars critical; the toggle still turned it off.
- `showBaselines`: absent drew the baseline bar, `false` none, `true` without baseline fields none.
- `readOnly`: the read-only badge, no resize handles, no Undo, no auto-schedule, and the drawer opened without a save path.
- `mobileReadOnly`: absent locked the chart at 639px and left it editable at 640px; `false` kept 420px editable; `readOnly: true` beside it still locked.

**`navigation`**, with and without a `RelatedRecordActionsProvider` record navigator mounted (the host the kanban and calendar `NavigationMembers-8652` pins use):

| Authored | No host | Host navigator mounted |
| --- | --- | --- |
| absent | drawer opens | drawer opens, `openRecord` 0 calls |
| `drawer` / `modal` / `popover` | that overlay opens | same, `openRecord` 0 |
| `split` | record beside the chart, chart still drawn | same |
| `page`, and mode-less `{ size: 'lg' }` | `pushState('/console/task/record/t1')` | the same push, `openRecord` 0 |
| `new_window`; `openNewTab` beside `drawer` or `page` | `window.open(record page, '_blank')` | same |
| `none`; `none` + `openNewTab`; `drawer` + `preventNavigation` | nothing | nothing |
| inline rows naming no object, absent / `drawer` / `page` | nothing | nothing |
| `data: { provider: 'object' }`, no `objectName`, `page` | push of that object's record page | same |

The gantt differs from the tree, the map and the timeline in two ways, and the description says both. It defaults an absent key to a drawer. It also hands `useNavigationOverlay` its own `onNavigate` (objectui#7334), so the hook's host-navigator branch (objectui#11293) is never reached: the address is the one the gantt derives from the page it is on. Parked at four locations: `/apps/demo/task/view/all` and `/apps/demo/task` gave `/apps/demo/task/record/t1`; `/apps/demo/page/plan` gave `/apps/demo/page/plan/task/record/t1`; `/apps/demo/project/record/p1` gave `/apps/demo/project/record/p1/task/record/t1`. The drawer's full-page link derives the same address. The pin carries the off-route row labelled "measured, not endorsed"; see Acceptance notes.

## Zone 2 hypotheses, as measured

- **H1 (loading)** held: one eager import judges the block in both directions.
- **H2 (the eleven keys)** held at base `edfcf5a5e`: the same eleven, all honoured. `label`'s object arm is the inline locale map, measured in both locales. `mobileReadOnly` was measured on the narrow path (639 / 640 / 420 / 1280px).
- **H3 (`navigation`)** partly falsified: the gantt is NOT the tree / map / timeline hook family in effect. Absent opens a drawer, and `page` never reaches the host navigator. The description is worded to the matrix above, and carries no "outranks the mode" sentence: `openNewTab` outranks every mode except `none`.
- **H4 (member pins)** held: ten rows. `filter` / `sort` were not promoted from `queryKeysDeclared-8220` (one rule and one sort item, no operator or inline reading), so they live in the new file.
- **H5 (mirrors)** falsified: nothing is newly declared on either face. The ten non-label keys are on `ObjectGanttSchema` (TS and zod) since objectui#5903, `navigation` by reference to the spec's `NavigationConfigSchema`; `label` is `BaseSchema`'s, which is the spec's `I18nLabelSchema` by reference; and the authored arm `ObjectGanttBlockSchema` takes the 17.5.0 row by reference since objectui#10859 batch 6. No `zod-mirror-parity` row opened.
- **H6 (ledger)** held, read off the guard's own census rows: `unjudgedBlocks` 1 (`object-timeline`), owner `objectui#11168` 4.

## Reverse verification

Committed first (`85c16d950`), then `packages/plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx` was taken back to `edfcf5a5e` (marker count 0, `percentageField` count 1, blob `d03aee8cf2ef`) and the pin plus the guard ran. Predicted and observed: exactly 6 red (the pin's four registration rows; the guard's `object-gantt publishes every top-level key` and `every member pin names a key that is still array/object-armed`), 290 green. Restored from `HEAD` by absolute path under a trap: blob `4b8e320b6301` equals `HEAD`'s, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates

Final head `e2d87546b`, through objectstack's `os-verify-lock.sh`, every log's first line the head sha:
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^...`: 34/34, VERDICT command-exit 0. Scoped doc build (`check-doc-snippet-types --build-filter`): 35/35, exit 0.
- `@object-ui/plugin-gantt type-check` (both its `tsc` runs, test config included) and `@object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0, script names echoed.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-gantt/` plus the guard and `filterContextTokensSweep-10666`: 98 files passed and 1 skipped (the zone-conditional objectui#10866 file), 1066 tests passed, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `new-line-citations` (0 new), `changeset-claims`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence` (4 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-overwrite` (1 added, 1 modified: the dated `6050` note, frontmatter byte-identical), `doc-fences`, `doc-snippets` (769 of 769), `doc-examples`, `doc-types`, `doc-example-ids`, `doc-example-readers`, `readme-exports`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `component-surface-parity`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `test-path-roots`, `vi-mock-specifiers` / `inherit` / `override-shape`, `installed-pin-claims`, `prompt-keys`, `registry-bare-names`, `unreferenced-sources`, `comment-mask-corpus`, `spec-symbols`, `shell-escape-residue`, `handler-key-reads`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins` (prerequisite: a console bundle). Its subject is the registrations a `sideEffects` array keeps; this diff touches no `sideEffects` array and no import graph.
- `changeset-claims` asked for three pending bodies to be re-read, `6470`, `6475` and `8067`; each still holds.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED for the 8 paths (control `AGENTS.md` exit 3).
- Lint, a declared narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 4 touched TS files gave 4 files, 0 errors, and 9 warnings, all on lines this PR does not touch. All four files are in the config's population (`--print-config` resolves each), and the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Off-route record-page address (finding, not fixed here).** On a console custom page, or another object's record page, a gantt's `page` / `new_window` and its drawer's full-page link go to the current address with `/OBJECT/record/ID` appended. The console's route table has no route for that shape (it falls to the catch-all not-found route). The host's record navigator, which objectui#11293 made the `page` seam, would answer it, but the gantt's own `onNavigate` outranks it. Reported in this slice's report for the seat to rule; the description and docs state the measured behaviour.
- **`data: { provider: 'schema', schemaId }` (finding, not fixed here).** The spec row accepts it. Measured, the gantt does not read it: it queries `objectName`, or the adapter with an empty object name when there is none. That contradicts the `data` description's "never queries `objectName`". No gantt producer writes this arm. The README no longer lists it as a source; the `object-gantt.data` pin claim says it is not pinned.
- **Commit trailer.** `85c16d950` ends with the harness's model-named co-author trailer instead of this repo's model-free pair. History is not rewritten; later commits carry the model-free pair.
- **Not this PR's:** `object-timeline` and its booking (c), the kanban / calendar `openNewTab` wording, the `ObjectTimelineProps.navigation` JSDoc, `endpoint` ×2 and `undoable`, objectui#11355's `ObjectGantt.tsx` conversions (this PR edits no line of `ObjectGantt.tsx`), and objectui#11348 / objectui#11364's types.
